name: directory-name-empty-subject-no-dir-san-valid
description: A directoryName permit does not constrain an empty subject when the certificate has no directoryName SAN. The leaf has an empty subject and a DNS SAN only, so the directoryName form is absent for constraint purposes and the chain is acceptable.
notes: RFC 5280 says directoryName restrictions apply to the subject field when the certificate includes a non-empty subject, and to directoryName SAN entries. Validators that treat the empty Name as a directoryName instance may falsely reject this chain.

certs.subject: C=US,O=NC Tests,CN=Empty Subject Directory Permit CA
